claims.rationale: The label states tiagabine showed no clinically important potentiation of alcohol's pharmacodynamic effects.
The label advises caution with ethanol because of possible additive nervous-system depressant effects, which the claim reports as a flag.
The double-blind abstract reports no evidence of a pharmacodynamic interaction on the measured cognitive, motor and subjective variables.
The abstract states the Cmax, Tmax and AUC of tiagabine and ethanol were unchanged during concomitant administration.
